interactives.label: Rules of the road
interactives.text: One party at a time. The waves come to you; the road behind stays quiet once you have cleared it. Fall and you rise at the last fire you passed. The waystones count you out.

interactives.label: Waystone
interactives.text: The waystone home. Using it counts you out of the run.

interactives.label: The tappers' spring
interactives.text: The tappers drank here and washed the resin off their hands. It never quite came off.

interactives.label: The Boar King's hoard
interactives.text: The road's cache. It opens once for each of you when the court is quiet.
